verses.en: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
verses.pt: Depois destas coisas a palavra do SENHOR veio a Abrão em visão, dizendo: Não temas, Abrão; eu sou o teu escudo; a tua recompensa será muito grande.
verses.en_web: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
verses.en_bbe: After these things, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Have no fear, Abram: I will keep you safe, and great will be your reward.

verses.en: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
verses.pt: Abrão respondeu: Senhor DEUS, que me darás, sendo que não tenho filho, e o herdeiro da minha casa é Eliézer de Damasco?
verses.en_web: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
verses.en_bbe: And Abram said, What will you give me? for I have no child and this Eliezer of Damascus will have all my wealth after me.

verses.en: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
verses.pt: Disse mais Abrão: Eis que não me deste descendência, e eis que meu herdeiro é um nascido em minha casa.
verses.en_web: Abram said, “Behold, to me you have given no children: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
verses.en_bbe: And Abram said, You have given me no child, and a servant in my house will get the heritage.

verses.en: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
verses.pt: E logo a palavra do SENHOR veio a ele dizendo: Não esse não herdará de ti, mas sim o que sairá de tuas entranhas será o que de ti herdará.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
verses.en_bbe: Then said the Lord, This man will not get the heritage, but a son of your body will have your property after you.

verses.en: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
verses.pt: E tirou-lhe fora, e disse: Olha agora aos céus, e conta as estrelas, se as podes contar. E lhe disse: Assim será tua descendência.
verses.en_web: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So will your offspring be.”
verses.en_bbe: And he took him out into the open air, and said to him, Let your eyes be lifted to heaven, and see if the stars may be numbered; even so will your seed be.

verses.en: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
verses.pt: E creu ao SENHOR, e contou-lhe por justiça.
verses.en_web: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: And he had faith in the Lord, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

verses.en: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe: Eu sou o SENHOR, que te tirei de Ur dos caldeus, para dar-te a herdar esta terra.
verses.en_web: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, I am the Lord, who took you from Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land for your heritage.

verses.en: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: Senhor DEUS, com que saberei que a vou herdar?
verses.en_web: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, O Lord God, how may I be certain that it will be mine?

verses.en: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
verses.pt: E lhe disse: Separa-me uma bezerra de três anos, e uma cabra de três anos, e um carneiro de três anos, uma rolinha também, e um pombinho.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Take a young cow of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a sheep of three years old, and a dove and a young pigeon.

verses.en: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
verses.pt: E tomou ele todas estas coisas, e partiu-as pela metade, e pôs cada metade uma em frente de outra; mas não partiu as aves.
verses.en_web: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
verses.en_bbe: All these he took, cutting them in two and putting one half opposite the other, but not cutting the birds in two.

verses.en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
verses.pt: E desciam aves sobre os corpos mortos, e enxotava-as Abrão.
verses.en_web: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
verses.en_bbe: And evil birds came down on the bodies, but Abram sent them away.

verses.en: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
verses.pt: Mas ao pôr do sol veio o sono a Abrão, e eis que o pavor de uma grande escuridão caiu sobre ele.
verses.en_web: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
verses.en_bbe: Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep came on Abram, and a dark cloud of fear.

verses.en: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.pt: Então disse a Abrão: Tem certeza que a tua descendência será peregrina em terra que não é sua, e serão escravizados e afligidos por quatrocentos anos.
verses.en_web: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to Abram, Truly, your seed will be living in a land which is not theirs, as servants to a people who will be cruel to them for four hundred years;

verses.en: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
verses.pt: Mas também a nação a quem servirão, eu julgarei; e depois disto sairão com grande riqueza.
verses.en_web: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth,
verses.en_bbe: But I will be the judge of that nation whose servants they are, and they will come out from among them with great wealth.

verses.en: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.pt: Tu, porém, virás aos teus pais em paz, e serás sepultado em boa velhice.
verses.en_web: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
verses.en_bbe: As for you, you will go to your fathers in peace; at the end of a long life you will be put in your last resting-place.

verses.en: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
verses.pt: E na quarta geração voltarão para cá; porque ainda não está completa a maldade dos amorreus até aqui.
verses.en_web: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
verses.en_bbe: And in the fourth generation they will come back here; for at present the sin of the Amorite is not full.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
verses.pt: E sucedeu que, depois de posto o sol, e já estando escuro, apareceu um fogo fumegando, e uma tocha de fogo que passou por entre os animais divididos.
verses.en_web: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
verses.en_bbe: Then when the sun went down and it was dark, he saw a smoking fire and a flaming light which went between the parts of the bodies.

verses.en: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.pt: Naquele dia fez o SENHOR um pacto com Abrão dizendo: À tua descendência darei esta terra desde o rio do Egito até o rio grande, o rio Eufrates;
verses.en_web: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.en_bbe: In that day the Lord made an agreement with Abram, and said, To your seed have I given this land from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

verses.en: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
verses.pt: Os queneus, e os quenezeus, e os cadmoneus,
verses.en_web: the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
verses.en_bbe: The Kenite, the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,

verses.en: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
verses.pt: E os heteus, e os perizeus, e os refains,
verses.en_web: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
verses.en_bbe: And the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,

verses.en: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
verses.pt: E os amorreus, e os cananeus, e os girgaseus, e os jebuseus.
verses.en_web: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.
